svg.title: Four questions, four metrics, one culprit
svg.desc: A hand-drawn decision tree for a wrong RAG answer. Four question ellipses ask in turn whether the right document was retrieved (context RECALL, measured 0.91), whether most of what was retrieved was relevant (context PRECISION, 0.62), whether every claim is supported (FAITHFULNESS, 0.88) and whether the answer addresses the question (ANSWER RELEVANCY, 0.84); each no-branch lands on a named component - retrieval, re-ranking, generation hallucination, query transformation - and the final yes lands on 'the answer is right'. Beside it a five-node agent trajectory shows node 3 crossed out with a red arc back to a ringed node 1 labelled 'step 3 failed BECAUSE of step 1', with attribution 1 of 5 for end-state evaluation against 5 of 5 for trajectory evaluation.
